title: Stallone on the Edge: The Making of Cliffhanger
original_title: Stallone on the Edge: The Making of Cliffhanger
overview: The making of action thriller "Cliffhanger" is hosted by leading star Sylvester Stallone. He presents some of the shoot's most difficult sequences while filming on the Italian Alps. Also interviewed are some cast members, director Renny Harlin and stunt-performers.
